description: Known-answer material for IFF Service Receipt v2 (ML-DSA-65). Construct envelope.payload as unpadded base64url of canonical_payload. The signed message is "iff-service-receipt/v2\n" || SHA-256(canonical_payload); signing_digest_sha256 is that SHA-256 and equals payload_sha256. Payloads are the v1 vector payloads with the v2 schema. Negative cases give the envelope to verify and the stable error code a verifier must report.
test_private_key_seed_warning: This key is intentionally public. Never trust a receipt because it uses this key.
signing: deterministic (FIPS 204 rnd = 32 zero bytes); production signatures are hedged

evidence_compute.description: Evidence/compute descriptor vector bound to transparency-log test leaf 5. Base verification binds the descriptor bytes only; it does not verify the referenced evidence or compute proof.

negative_cases.name: tampered_payload
negative_cases.mutation: replace checkout_7f3a with checkout_7f3b in canonical_payload without changing payload_sha256 or signature

negative_cases.name: tampered_signature
negative_cases.mutation: flip the first decoded signature byte

negative_cases.name: wrong_expected_issuer
negative_cases.mutation: verify the valid envelope with expected issuer https://other.example

negative_cases.name: noncanonical_public_key_base64url
negative_cases.mutation: change the final public-key character so the unused trailing bits are non-zero (1952 bytes leave two unused bits)

negative_cases.name: v1_schema_with_mldsa_signature
negative_cases.mutation: set the envelope schema to the v1 schema and keep the ML-DSA-65 algorithm, key and signature

negative_cases.name: v2_schema_with_ed25519_algorithm
negative_cases.mutation: set signature.algorithm to Ed25519 on the v2 envelope

negative_cases.name: v2_schema_with_ed25519_key_and_signature
negative_cases.mutation: v2 envelope whose public_key is a 32-byte Ed25519 key and whose value is a 64-byte Ed25519 signature, key_id derived from that key

negative_cases.name: v1_signing_digest_signed_with_mldsa
negative_cases.mutation: ML-DSA-65 signature over the 32-byte v1 digest SHA-256("iff-service-receipt/v1\n" || payload)

negative_cases.name: domainless_digest_signed_with_mldsa
negative_cases.mutation: ML-DSA-65 signature over SHA-256(payload) without the domain line

negative_cases.name: public_key_one_byte_short
negative_cases.mutation: drop the last public-key byte (1951 bytes) and derive key_id from the short key

negative_cases.name: signature_one_byte_short
negative_cases.mutation: drop the last signature byte (3308 bytes)

negative_cases.name: payload_schema_differs_from_envelope_schema
negative_cases.mutation: validly sign a payload whose schema is the v1 schema inside a v2 envelope

negative_cases.name: directory_entry_algorithm_mismatch
negative_cases.mutation: a directory entry with the receipt's key_id and public_key but algorithm Ed25519 must not recognize the receipt
